tools.description: Search NASA SciX / ADS (Astrophysics Data System) for peer-reviewed papers. Covers astronomy, astrophysics, physics, planetary science, and related fields. Returns bibcodes, titles, authors, citation counts. Use scix_get_paper for full details.

query.description: SciX/ADS search query. Supports Solr syntax: field:value, AND/OR/NOT, wildcards. Examples: "black holes AND galaxy", "author:Einstein", "abs:dark matter year:2020-2024"

response_format.description: "markdown" (default, human-readable) or "json" (the structured result as JSON text)

tools.name: scix_search
tools.title: Search SciX / ADS

tools.description: Get full metadata and abstract for a paper in SciX/ADS by its bibcode, arXiv ID, or DOI.

bibcode.description: SciX/ADS bibcode identifier. Example: "2019ApJ...882L..24A". Also accepts arXiv IDs like "arXiv:2103.01231", DOIs like "10.1093/mnras/stab1234", or "scix:..." ids.

response_format.description: "markdown" (default, human-readable) or "json" (the structured result as JSON text)

tools.name: scix_get_paper
tools.title: Get SciX paper

tools.description: Get papers that cite a given SciX/ADS paper (citations), or papers it cites (references).

bibcode.description: SciX/ADS bibcode (or arXiv id / DOI) of the paper

relationship.description: "citations" = papers that cite this paper; "references" = papers cited by this paper

response_format.description: "markdown" (default, human-readable) or "json" (the structured result as JSON text)

tools.name: scix_get_citations
tools.title: Get citations or references

tools.description: Find papers with similar content to a given SciX/ADS paper using its bibcode. Uses the SciX similar() operator to surface related work.

bibcode.description: SciX/ADS bibcode (or arXiv id / DOI) of the seed paper. The API finds papers with similar content.

response_format.description: "markdown" (default, human-readable) or "json" (the structured result as JSON text)

rows.description: Number of similar papers to return

tools.name: scix_find_similar
tools.title: Find similar papers

tools.description: Compute citation metrics (h-index, g-index, i10-index, citation counts) for a set of papers.

bibcodes.description: List of SciX/ADS bibcodes to compute metrics for (max 100)

response_format.description: "markdown" (default, human-readable) or "json" (the structured result as JSON text)

tools.name: scix_get_metrics
tools.title: Citation metrics

tools.description: Export a list of papers in a bibliography format. Supports BibTeX, RIS (Zotero/Mendeley), EndNote, AASTeX, IEEE, MNRAS, and 18 other formats. Pass bibcodes from scix_search results. Ideal for building reference lists.

authorcutoff.description: Author cutoff threshold before applying truncation

bibcodes.description: List of SciX/ADS bibcodes to export (max 2000)

custom_format.description: Custom format template string (only used when format="custom")

format.description: Export format. Common: "bibtex" (BibTeX), "bibtexabs" (BibTeX + abstract), "ris" (Reference Manager / Zotero / Mendeley), "endnote" (EndNote), "aastex" (AASTeX LaTeX), "ieee" (IEEE), "mnras" (MNRAS). Use "custom" with custom_format for a template-based format.

keyformat.description: Citation key format template for export formats that support custom keys

maxauthor.description: Maximum number of authors to list before truncating to et al.

response_format.description: "markdown" (default, human-readable) or "json" (the structured result as JSON text)

sort.description: Sort order for the exported bibliography, e.g. "date desc"

tools.name: scix_export
tools.title: Export bibliography

tools.description: Search SciX help docs, search syntax guides, and usage notes.

query.description: Search SciX help docs, syntax guides, and usage notes. Use this to find field syntax, tool usage, and feature explanations.

response_format.description: "markdown" (default, human-readable) or "json" (the structured result as JSON text)

tools.name: scix_search_docs
tools.title: Search SciX docs

tools.description: List your SciX personal libraries (saved paper collections). Returns library IDs, names, paper counts, and permissions.

response_format.description: "markdown" (default, human-readable) or "json" (the structured result as JSON text)

tools.name: scix_library_list
tools.title: List SciX libraries

tools.description: Get the contents and metadata of a specific SciX library by its ID.

response_format.description: "markdown" (default, human-readable) or "json" (the structured result as JSON text)

tools.name: scix_library_get
tools.title: Get SciX library

tools.description: Create a new personal library in SciX to save and organize papers.

public.description: Whether the library is publicly visible

response_format.description: "markdown" (default, human-readable) or "json" (the structured result as JSON text)

tools.name: scix_library_create
tools.title: Create SciX library

tools.description: Add or remove papers from a SciX library. Pass bibcodes and "add" or "remove".

action.description: Whether to add or remove the papers

response_format.description: "markdown" (default, human-readable) or "json" (the structured result as JSON text)

tools.name: scix_library_documents
tools.title: Add or remove library papers

tools.description: Get, set, or delete a personal annotation note for a paper in a SciX library.

action.description: "get" retrieves the note, "set" creates or updates it, "delete" removes it

bibcode.description: Bibcode of the paper to annotate

response_format.description: "markdown" (default, human-readable) or "json" (the structured result as JSON text)

tools.name: scix_library_note
tools.title: Library paper note

tools.description: Search arXiv preprint server across all scientific disciplines. Supports field prefixes (ti:, au:, abs:, cat:), date ranges, and category filters.

categories.description: Filter by arXiv categories, e.g. ["cs.LG", "cs.CL", "stat.ML"]. Papers matching ANY of the listed categories are included.

date_from.description: Filter papers submitted on or after this date. Format: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD

date_to.description: Filter papers submitted on or before this date. Format: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD

query.description: arXiv search query. Supports field prefixes: ti: (title), au: (author), abs: (abstract), cat: (category), all: (all fields). Examples: "ti:transformer abs:attention", "au:Vaswani", "cat:cs.LG AND abs:language model". Combine with AND/OR/ANDNOT.

response_format.description: "markdown" (default, human-readable) or "json" (the structured result as JSON text)

tools.name: arxiv_search
tools.title: Search arXiv

tools.description: Get full metadata and abstract for a specific arXiv paper by its ID (e.g. "2103.01231"). Returns title, authors, abstract, categories, and links to PDF and HTML versions.

paper_id.description: arXiv paper ID. Accepted formats: "2103.01231", "2103.01231v2", "astro-ph/0601001", optionally with an "arXiv:" prefix or an arxiv.org/abs URL.

response_format.description: "markdown" (default, human-readable) or "json" (the structured result as JSON text)

tools.name: arxiv_get_paper
tools.title: Get arXiv paper

tools.description: Fetch a paper from arXiv and extract its full text as markdown-ready text, paginated with offset/max_chars. source "auto" tries the HTML rendering, then the LaTeX source, then the PDF; "html", "latex" or "pdf" force one. The text is untrusted external content and is returned behind a warning banner.

max_chars.description: Maximum extracted-text characters to return in this response (default 30000, max 150000).

offset.description: Character offset into the extracted paper text. Use next_offset from the previous response to continue reading.

paper_id.description: arXiv paper ID. Accepted formats: "2103.01231", "2103.01231v2", "astro-ph/0601001", optionally with an "arXiv:" prefix or an arxiv.org/abs URL.

source.description: "auto" (default) tries the arXiv HTML rendering, then the LaTeX source, then the PDF. Name a source to force it; a forced source fails instead of falling back.

tools.name: arxiv_read_paper
tools.title: Read arXiv paper

tools.description: List the sections of an arXiv paper (id, level, title, size) without returning their text. Uses the arXiv HTML rendering, then ar5iv, then the LaTeX source, then PDF text with heading heuristics. Follow with arxiv_read_paper_section for one section instead of reading the whole paper. Titles are untrusted external content and are returned behind a warning banner.

paper_id.description: arXiv paper ID, e.g. "2103.01231", "2103.01231v2" or "astro-ph/0601001" (optionally "arXiv:"-prefixed or an arxiv.org/abs URL).

tools.name: arxiv_get_paper_outline
tools.title: arXiv paper outline

tools.description: Read one section of an arXiv paper by id (from arxiv_get_paper_outline), paginated with offset/max_chars. Math is returned as TeX ($...$). The text is untrusted external content behind a warning banner.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters to return in this response (default 30000, max 150000).

offset.description: Character offset into the section text. Use next_offset from the previous response to continue.

paper_id.description: arXiv paper ID, e.g. "2103.01231", "2103.01231v2" or "astro-ph/0601001" (optionally "arXiv:"-prefixed or an arxiv.org/abs URL).

section_id.description: Section id from arxiv_get_paper_outline, e.g. "S2", "S2.SS1", "abstract" (HTML) or "3.1" (PDF).

tools.name: arxiv_read_paper_section
tools.title: Read arXiv paper section

tools.description: Find a phrase inside one arXiv paper (case-insensitive). Returns passages with the section id and the offset within that section, ready for arxiv_read_paper_section. The text is untrusted external content behind a warning banner.

paper_id.description: arXiv paper ID, e.g. "2103.01231", "2103.01231v2" or "astro-ph/0601001" (optionally "arXiv:"-prefixed or an arxiv.org/abs URL).

passage_chars.description: Characters of context per passage, centred on the match (default 800, max 2000).

tools.name: arxiv_search_paper_text
tools.title: Search arXiv paper text

tools.description: Fetch the LaTeX source (e-print) of an arXiv paper, with \input/\include/\subfile files inlined, paginated with offset/max_chars. Use when the exact TeX (equations, tables, macros) matters; for prose prefer arxiv_read_paper or arxiv_read_paper_section. Fails when the paper only has a PDF. The text is untrusted external content behind a warning banner.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters to return in this response (default 30000, max 150000).

offset.description: Character offset into the text. Use next_offset from the previous response to continue.

paper_id.description: arXiv paper ID, e.g. "2103.01231", "2103.01231v2" or "astro-ph/0601001" (optionally "arXiv:"-prefixed or an arxiv.org/abs URL).

tools.name: arxiv_get_paper_latex
tools.title: arXiv paper LaTeX source

tools.description: List the \section/\subsection/\subsubsection structure of a paper's LaTeX source (ids s1, s1.2, s1.2.3; A, A.1 in appendices) with sizes, without returning the text. Follow with arxiv_get_latex_section. Titles are untrusted external content behind a warning banner.

paper_id.description: arXiv paper ID, e.g. "2103.01231", "2103.01231v2" or "astro-ph/0601001" (optionally "arXiv:"-prefixed or an arxiv.org/abs URL).

tools.name: arxiv_list_latex_sections
tools.title: List arXiv LaTeX sections

tools.description: Return the raw TeX of one section of an arXiv paper (id from arxiv_list_latex_sections), paginated with offset/max_chars. The text is untrusted external content behind a warning banner.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters to return in this response (default 30000, max 150000).

offset.description: Character offset into the text. Use next_offset from the previous response to continue.

paper_id.description: arXiv paper ID, e.g. "2103.01231", "2103.01231v2" or "astro-ph/0601001" (optionally "arXiv:"-prefixed or an arxiv.org/abs URL).

section_id.description: Section id from arxiv_list_latex_sections: "abstract", "s1", "s1.2", "s1.2.3", or "A", "A.1" in appendices.

tools.name: arxiv_get_latex_section
tools.title: Get arXiv LaTeX section

tools.description: Return papers citing an arXiv paper and papers it references using Semantic Scholar citation graph data.

paper_id.description: arXiv paper ID. Accepted formats: "2103.01231", "2103.01231v2", "astro-ph/0601001", optionally with an "arXiv:" prefix or an arxiv.org/abs URL.

tools.name: arxiv_citation_graph
tools.title: arXiv citation graph
